page.name: Content page
page.description: Articles and categories, with a reading layout that follows your help center.
page.title: Title
page.related_pages_info: One existing page path per line, for example /getting-started. Only accessible pages are displayed.

help_center.name: Help center
help_center.description: Search, topic cards, featured knowledge and an optional contact section.

faqs.name: FAQ center
faqs.description: Questions and expandable answers first, followed by topics and featured knowledge.

support.name: Support home
support.description: A compact main column with a sticky contact sidebar.

card.name: Card home
card.description: Large cards preview each topic and its articles.
card.hero_pc_image_info: A wide image works best. Leave empty to show no background image.
card.hero_mobile_image_info: Uses the desktop image when empty.
card.hero_title_info: Uses the page title when empty, then the site name.
card.hero_text_color_info: Used for both the title and the description.
card.show_channels_info: Creates one card for each top-level topic.

content.label: Source content
content.info: Preserved from the source and displayed in every homepage variant.

hero_description.label: Welcome description
hero_description.info: A short introduction. Uses the site tagline when left blank.

hero_image.label: Brand or product image
hero_image.info: Optional. Choose a real image for your brand or product.

featured_title.label: Featured section heading
featured_title.info: Leave blank to use the default heading.

featured_pages.label: Featured article paths
featured_pages.info: One real page path per line. Missing or inaccessible pages are skipped. Leave blank to hide the section.

show_channels.label: Show topics
show_channels.info: Turn this off to hide the topic section on the homepage.

faq_source.label: Questions collection path
faq_source.info: Use a real collection path. Leave blank to use home. Child collections are links; child articles show a summary and a link to the full text.

show_faqs.label: Show questions section
show_faqs.info: The FAQ home always displays this section; other variants use this switch.

theme.title: Help & Support Center
theme.description: Help customers find answers through search, topics, and products.
theme.tagline_default: Find your answer. Keep moving forward.
theme.primary_nav_menu_info: One item per line, formatted as Title[URL. Leave empty to hide the menu.
theme.footer_text_default: Find your answer. Keep moving forward.
